title: Add fastPath upload option
body:
Adds an opt-in `fastPath` upload option for callers that need the upload stored quickly. It skips thumbnail generation and resizes to the large variant only. Thumbnail jobs per upload go from 3 → 0 on the fast path.

With `fastPath` unset (the default) every step runs exactly as before; `pipeline.test.ts` asserts the default call order is unchanged.

Plan: plan.md
